summary: Bearer's wielded weapons or shield (one or the other) can only be destroyed or damaged by object-destroying Magic Balls or Verbals.

effects.subject: bearer-equipment
effects.note: Only Magic Balls or Verbals which destroy objects (e.g. Fireball, Pyrotechnics) can destroy or damage them. Covers either the weapons or the shield, not both.

restrictions.note: Affects either the bearer's weapons or their shield, not both.

references.name: Fireball
references.note: A Magic Ball that destroys objects and so still affects Hardened equipment.

references.name: Pyrotechnics
references.note: A Verbal that destroys objects and so still affects Hardened equipment.

clarifications.text: Only one of the bearer's weapons or shield is protected, not both.

open_questions: L1 does not say who chooses between weapons and shield, or when.
